raw.description:
Department: Engineering

Location: Home based with occasional travel to the London office

Reports to: Engineering Manager

Hours: 37.5 per week

Salary: (Depending on experience)

A quick note before you apply: This role is strictly UK-based and must be performed entirely within the United Kingdom; we do not employ remote staff overseas, nor do we offer relocation support. Candidates must have the legal right to work in the UK prior to commencing employment. While we hold a sponsor licence, visa sponsorship is only considered in exceptional circumstances and is not available as standard for this vacancy

Role Overview

This is a new role. Our culture at Cambridge Spark: engineers who own business outcomes, not just feature backlogs, and who work directly with stakeholders to understand problems rather than waiting for specifications to arrive.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be an early member of a new Engineering Pod: these are small, autonomous teams responsible for the quality, usability, and impact of EDUKATE.ai for the people learning through it and the teams supporting them. You will work across the full platform, from understanding what your pod’s stakeholders actually need, through to shipping and iterating on the solutions you help shape. You will be a multiplier for the engineers around you: raising the bar on how the team thinks about problems, not just how it solves them.

This role reports to one of our Engineering Managers, and you will initially join our Internal Experience pod. You will carry seniority in a team that we're deliberately rebuilding around product ownership and outcome focus.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery within the Internal Experience pod: from discovery and problem framing through to production, iteration, and outcome measurement
  • Work directly with internal stakeholders — curriculum, operations, delivery — to understand problems at their root, not just their surface symptoms
  • Shape solutions collaboratively: contribute to proposals, decision records, and discovery conversations, not just pull requests
  • Bring an AI-first approach to your work: use AI tooling actively in prototyping, agentic coding, and accelerating delivery — and help the wider team develop the same habits
  • Hold a high engineering standard across the pod: TDD, code review discipline, and a genuine commitment to quality are non-negotiable here
  • Coach and support less experienced engineers in the pod, sharing your experience of what good looks like in a product engineering context
  • Contribute to the evolution of our engineering practices as the pod model matures

Candidate Specification

Technical

  • Front-end expertise, including UX design: we want to make our product delight internal users and free their time to serve learners
  • Comfort owning the full delivery lifecycle: problem framing, solution design, production, and iteration
  • Strong engineering fundamentals: test-driven development, code review culture, and a demonstrable commitment to quality
  • Active engagement with AI-assisted development: prototyping, agentic coding, and using AI tooling as an accelerant rather than a novelty
  • Experience with edtech, regulated industries, or other complex domains is a plus; the ability to absorb a new domain quickly is essential
  • Professional experience in our stack (React / Vue) is a bonus, but not essential
  • Back-end engineering knowledge is a nice-to-have for this role

Stakeholder and Communication

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with non-technical stakeholders to shape requirements — through product engineering, professional services, client-facing delivery, or similar
  • Strong written communication: you can write a clear proposal, a concise technical decision record, or a stakeholder update that lands without needing translation
  • Comfortable running or contributing to discovery conversations, not just delivering code once the brief is written

Ways of Working

  • Outcome ownership over feature delivery. You question whether the proposed solution is the right one, not just whether you can build it.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. Small pods mean limited process overhead. You make good decisions with incomplete information and know when to escalate versus when to proceed.
  • AI-first mindset. You are not just curious about AI; you actively use it, prototype with it, and bring that practice into the team around you.
  • Collaboration without ego. You care about the outcome more than the credit. You build trust through competence and consistency, not volume.
  • Communicative. You surface problems early, document your thinking, and keep stakeholders appropriately informed without being prompted.

What This Role Is Not

  • It is not a ticket-completion role: if you want a well-defined backlog and a clear brief every sprint, this is probably not the right fit
  • It is not a people management role: you will not have direct reports, though you will be a senior presence in the pod and expected to act like one
  • It is not a big-company environment: we are a bootstrapped edtech business; you will need to be comfortable with resource constraints and a degree of ambiguity about what comes next

Why This Role

  • A genuine opportunity to shape how product engineering works at Cambridge Spark, not just execute a predetermined roadmap
  • Direct access to and influence with senior leadership, including the Head of Engineering and CEO
  • Work that matters: our platform supports thousands of learners across data and AI apprenticeships, and the quality of what you build has a real and traceable impact on their experience and careers
  • An AI-serious engineering culture: we are an AI company and expect our engineering practice to reflect that, including giving you time and space to experiment
  • A stable, values-driven business with a social impact mission in education and skills

Company Benefits

  • Pension with 4% matched contributions, opportunity to opt into salary sacrifice scheme
  • 25 days holiday + flexi bank holidays + 1 day off on your birthday
  • A day for volunteering
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
  • Health & wellbeing allowance of up to £30 per month
  • Annual summer and Christmas events
  • Company socials including Cambridge College formals, pub nights, and team building events
  • CPD allowance alongside quarterly reflections to ring-fence time for development and growth
  • Private medical insurance and cash plan
  • Holiday buy-back scheme (up to 10 days per annum)
  • Employee Assistance Programme with a dedicated company counsellor

Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.

Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Cambridge Spark is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cambridge Spark are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, colour or ethnicity, ability or disability, gender or gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Cambridge Spark will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Cambridge Spark encourages applicants of all ages.

Job Description :

JOB SUMMARY

This job provides front line staff guidance, ensures effective and efficient delivery of Pharmacy call center services. Serves as first line reviewer in monitoring and ensuring adherence to the health plan’s state and federal multiple drug benefit design offerings. The incumbent responds to physician and pharmacy network provider inquiries concerning oral, injectable and infusion medication requests, and drug claim edits/prior authorizations. Clearly defines the medical necessity of non-formulary and prior authorization medication exception requests, by reviewing member claims history,. Interacts with pharmacy network providers to evaluate, educate and/or assist in addressing denied point of sale prescription claim transitions and coordination of benefits practices/procedures.


Work Schedule for this position is Monday/Wednesday/Friday 8:30 AM - 5:00 PM EST & Tuesday/Thursday 9:00 AM - 5:30 PM EST


ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Communicate effectively with physician and pharmacy network providers to ensure that the needs of the provider and plan member are addressed in a courteous, helpful and timely manner.
  • Interact with staff to implement processes and problem solves.
  • Respond to drug benefit design inquires or exception requests and evaluate/direct daily workflow within the department.
  • Prioritize requests for drug authorizations or denials.
  • Review of prior authorization criteria for drug products.
  • Recommend staffing adjustments necessary to appropriately maintain a level of high efficiency/productivity.
  • Ensure adherence to call center turn around time requirements associated with DPW/CMS regulations.
  • Take necessary steps to perform a complete and accurate evaluation of all non-formulary drug exception requests prior to approval, authorization or claim override.
  • Search member claim history profile and recommend formulary alternatives wherever feasible.
  • Contact physician network provider to obtain necessary and/or additional information when necessary.
  • Consult with staff clinical pharmacist for guidance and assistance as necessary.
  • Document all authorizations and denials completely and accurately, and in accordance with timelines as defined by state and federal regulations to insure appropriate notification issuance to prescribing physician and impacted member.
  • Populate all authorization and denial information fields within the OnBase information system.
  • Enter all authorizations into the Argus IPNS information system to allow claim adjudication.
  • Complete other assigned duties as specified.
  • Identify and report improper coordination of benefit billing practices through paid clams review.
  • Participate as pharmacy representative in onsite member appeals and grievances sessions.
  • Serve as a resource for technical staff.
  • Other duties as assigned or requested.

Minimum

  • High school diploma or GED
  • Experience in pharmacy prescription claims processing/submission/payment

Preferred

  • Associate degree
  • Pharmacy technician certification certificate
  • Experience working in a managed care medication formulary management environment
  • Working knowledge of retail pharmacy and/or third party prescription procession
  • Strong background and understanding of medications and formulary terminology
  • Pharmacy technicians must be familiar with multiple Medicaid drug benefit design offerings and rules/regulations across multiple states. They must also be familiar with Medicare drug benefit design offerings that may differ by state, while being familiar with applicable federal rules/regulations that remain consistent throughout the nation

  • Excellent interpersonal, communication and attentive listening skills
  • Strong organizational skills, detail oriented
  • Demonstrated excellence in communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to work well with others
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast paced, multi-task environment

Remote/Work from Home

Does this role supervise/manage other employees?

No

Is Travel Required?

No

raw.description:
PROJECT MANAGER - DISASTER RECOVERY, HOUSING & COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TRAINING & TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE

ICF’s Justice, Workforce, Preparedness & Community Development group works to improve Americans’ lives through strategic consulting support, technical assistance, product development, and program implementation. We are seeking a PROJECT MANAGER candidate to join the Housing and Community Development team at ICF who is enthusiastic about solving social issues related to disaster recovery, community development, and building the capacity of state, territorial, and local governments to administer disaster recovery programs.

ICF seeks a self-motivated Project Manager - Disaster Recovery, Housing and Community Development Training and Technical Assistance to be an integral member of our multidisciplinary team in leading technical assistance and capacity building efforts for the U.S. Housing and Urban Development as part of the Community Compass Technical Assistance program. The primary focus is leading, coordinating, and managing technical assistance workstreams to provide guidance and strategic advising to disaster-impacted communities in their use of HUD’s Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funding.

The position will be responsible for leading and supporting a range of technical assistance engagements, providing direct guidance to grantees, and overseeing the development of products and training materials designed to help support federally-assisted disaster recovery and community development programs. This position requires strong project management experience and deep knowledge of HUD disaster recovery program activities. This position may also support additional TA engagements related to housing and community development, cross-cutting requirements for federal funding, and/or resilience and hazard mitigation work, however the primary function of the role is operational leadership in managing timelines, deliverables, contributors, and quality control across complex TA assignments.

This role can be located anywhere in the continental US. Candidates located in Mountain or Pacific Time Zones or willing to work after traditional Eastern time zone work hours preferred.

To apply, please submit a cover letter and resume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leading the operations of large and small training and technical assistance (TTA) engagements to provide guidance to states, territories, cities, counties, and other entities receiving Community Development Block Grant Disaster Recovery (CDBG-DR) funding
  • Directing cross functional teams of trainers, subject matter experts, and technical contributors, including strategizing on how to accomplish TA goals and build the capacity of TA recipients
  • Serving as the primary liaison with TA recipients, and maintaining clear communications with HUD
  • Coordinating delivery of trainings on regulatory and grant-specific requirements, including but not limited to policies and procedures, national objectives, procurement, coordination with other federal funding streams, labor standards, citizen participation, and overall compliance
  • Drawing on experience in housing, infrastructure, public services and economic revitalization to provide guidance to TA recipients on the design and implementation of their recovery and resilience programs
  • Overseeing product development work plans, including coordinating with authors, designers, subject-matter experts, and other contributors to ensure the creation of high-quality products
  • Performing project management responsibilities, including overseeing schedules, staffing, and budgets to ensure the production of quality project deliverables
  • Tracking priorities to ensure successful completion of projects in an accurate, timely, and cost-effective manner
  • Conducting quality control for deliverables, tools, and products to ensure accuracy, consistency, and alignment with HUD guidance and regulations, including review and approval of SME-developed content

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Urban Planning, Public Administration, or other relevant field
  • Minimum 8 years of experience working directly with CDBG-DR programs
  • Minimum 2 years Project management and personnel management skills and experience developing and implementing project/team processes
  • Demonstrated knowledge of how housing, community and economic development, and disaster recovery programs are implemented at the state and/or local levels
  • Willingness to travel occasionally

Preferred Experience

  • Master’s Degree in Public Policy, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Urban Planning, Public Administration, or other relevant field
  • Experience at a grantee or consulting firm with direct experience managing CDBG-DR programs
  • Experience working with multifamily developers, housing authorities, and developers of affordable housing
  • Experience with hazard mitigation and resilience strategies and analysis of data to inform risk reduction strategies

Professional Skills You Will Use

  • Excellent verbal, interpersonal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Strong project leadership, with ability to manage competing priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Ability to prioritize, multitask, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively with all levels of internal staff, clients and partners
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze situations to identify existing or potential problems and recommend solutions
  • Proficiency with MS Office software (i.e., Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams)
  • High level of professionalism, judgment, tact, and diplomacy
  • Superior attention to detail

 

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.


We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.


Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Reasonable Accommodations

Reasonable Accommodations are available, including, but not limited to, for disabled veterans, individuals with disabilities, and individuals with sincerely held religious beliefs, in all phases of the application and employment process. To request an accommodation, please email  and we will be happy to assist. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

We are looking for a Quality Assurance (QA) engineer to develop and execute exploratory and automated tests to ensure product quality. QA engineer responsibilities include designing and implementing tests, debugging and defining corrective actions. You will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics (e.g. defect densities and open defect counts.) The QA technician role plays an important part in our company’s product development process. Our ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting tests before product launches to ensure software runs smoothly and meets client needs, while being cost-effective. If you hold an engineering background and enjoy providing end-to-end solutions to software quality problems, we’d like to meet you. Ultimately, you should monitor all stages of software development to identify and resolve system malfunctions to meet quality standards.

Responsibilities

  • Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback

  • Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities

Our engineers build with AI every day. Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools are part of the standard toolchain here, not an experiment. We stay vendor-neutral across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-weight models, and we run Valkyrie, our own production layer, when a single interface to any model is the right call.

Azumo is a San Francisco based software development company that has been building intelligent applications since 2016. We provide nearshore AI engineering teams to organizations that need production AI faster than they can hire for it: as an embedded engineering team, as AI staff augmentation alongside an existing team, or as a full project build. We hire for seniority and test for it before anyone joins a client team. We support engineers in going deep on the modern AI stack, and we give time back to open-source work, community teaching, and philanthropy.

Job description:

Revenue Cycle Manager

The Revenue Cycle Manager will serve as a hands-on player-coach, overseeing billing, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and financial operations for ABA Therapy Partners. This role is ideal for a strategic, solutions-oriented leader who can manage day-to-day operations while identifying opportunities to streamline workflows, improve accuracy, strengthen collections, and reduce manual processes through automation and scalable solutions. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of revenue cycle best practices, billing requirements, authorization processes, and reimbursement rules for California regional centers, school districts, and insurance payers. Reporting directly to the CEO, this individual will play a key role in strengthening financial processes, improving revenue performance, and building the operational infrastructure needed to support the company’s continued growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Process Improvement

  • Process Mapping: Document every finance workflow end to end (session data to invoice to payment to cash to month-end close) with clear owners, inputs, outputs, deadlines, and handoffs.
  • Find and Fix Friction: Identify bottlenecks, rework, duplicate entry, and error sources. Prioritize fixes by impact on the business.
  • Automation: Lead automation across billing, AR, AP, and reporting using our systems (HiRasmus, Lumary, Rippling, Quickbooks, Google Workspace) and other tools as needed.
  • Standard Operating Procedures: Write and maintain SOPs and checklists so any team member can be trained to run each process the same way every time.
  • Controls: Build in checks that catch errors before they reach a client or vendor, with clear separation of duties and approval rules.
  • Continuous Improvement: Set baselines, track improvement, and report what changed each quarter.

2. Billing

  • Billing Cycle: Lead the monthly billing cycle for all clients we directly invoice, including Regional Centers and School Districts. Work directly with outsourced billing partners to drive prompt and accurate insurance client billing and collections.
  • Data Integrity: Partner with the appointment rendering and scheduling teams so the data used for billing is clean and complete before billing begins. Close the gaps that cause unrendered or unbilled sessions.
  • Client Billing: Convert documented sessions and session notes into invoices based on authorized hours, rates, and codes (e.g., regional center Purchase of Service agreements and school district contracts and IEPs).
  • Invoice Submission: Manage submissions according to each client's requirements, and resolve discrepancies or denials quickly.

3. Accounts Receivable and Collections

  • AR Management: Own the AR aging, follow up on overdue invoices, and drive down days sales outstanding (DSO), regardless of payer source or billing method.
  • Cash Application: Post incoming payments accurately in our Practice Management system and reconcile them to invoices.
  • Denials and Disputes: Track root causes of short pays, denials, and disputes, and fix the process upstream so they don't repeat.
  • Outsourced Billing Partners: Own the relationship to drive partnership, data integrity, clean claims, prompt payment and collections.
  • Self Pay / Patient Responsibility: Work with families in a professional, respectful manner to establish payment plans and otherwise collect on copays, coinsurance and other patient responsibility items.

4. Accounts Payable

  • Vendor Payments: Manage vendor setup, invoice intake, approvals, and payments on a predictable schedule, meeting vendor payment terms.
  • Approval Workflow: Enforce spending approval thresholds and documentation, and keep AP clean for audits.
  • Spend Visibility: Track recurring spend and subscriptions. Identify savings opportunities.

5. Finance Operations

  • Monthly Financial Rhythm: Define and run a monthly calendar for billing, collections, payment posting, AP, reconciliations, and close.
  • Month-End Close: Support an accurate, on-time close of financials (Quickbooks) with reconciliations and clean handoff / collaboration with our CPA and accounting partners.
  • Cash Management: Monitor cash position weekly and keep leadership 60 days ahead of cash needs.
  • Audit and Compliance: Keep billing and payment records audit-ready and aligned with client contracts and expectations, and funder rules.

6. Analysis, Forecasting, and Reporting

  • KPI Reporting: Produce weekly and monthly finance scorecards: billed vs. authorized hours, unrendered sessions, collection rate, DSO, AR aging, AP aging, cash position, and margin by client and school district.
  • Forecasting: Build and maintain rolling revenue, cash flow, expense and net income forecasts. Update them as placements, rates, and staffing levels change.
  • Budgeting: Support the annual budget and forecasts, and track actual performance against it.
  • Business Analysis: Analyze profitability by client, district, and service line, model the impact of rate changes and new contracts, and support pricing and growth decisions.
  • Ad Hoc Analysis: Answer leadership's financial questions quickly with clear, data-centered analysis.

7. Team Leadership and Collaboration

  • Supervision: Lead billing and finance specialists, providing training, feedback, and clear workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with clinical operations, scheduling, HR, and leadership so finance processes fit the realities of the business.

Knowledge and Experience Requirements

  • Revenue Cycle Management: Minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue cycle management, healthcare or behavioral health billing, or a comparable financial operations role.
  • California Regional Center and School District Billing: Minimum of 3 years of experience billing California Regional Centers under the Department of Developmental Services (DDS) and 3 years of experience with school district billing. Demonstrated knowledge of authorization verification, unit-based billing, documentation requirements, reimbursement rules, and billing compliance. Experience with insurance billing and the Self-Determination Program (SDP) is preferred.
  • Accounting and Financial Operations: Minimum of 5 years of experience directly managing accounts receivable (AR), accounts payable (AP), cash application, account reconciliations, and month-end close processes.
  • Process Improvement and Automation: Demonstrated success evaluating and redesigning workflows, improving billing accuracy, reducing denials and errors, shortening collection cycles, and implementing process improvements or automation to increase efficiency.
  • Financial Analysis and Reporting: Advanced spreadsheet skills, with experience developing financial forecasts, reporting dashboards, performance metrics, and financial models to support business decisions.
  • Systems and Technology: 3+ years experience with accounting, billing, payer portals and practice-management systems. Familiarity with Lumary and Rippling is preferred. Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies is a plus.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, or a related field preferred. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered.

Core Competencies and Soft Skills

  • Analytical and Detail-Oriented: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Continuous Improvement Mindset: Takes a proactive, hands-on approach to identifying inefficiencies, challenging existing processes, and developing scalable solutions rather than relying on the status quo.
  • Communication and Collaboration: Communicates financial information, performance trends, and operational issues clearly to both finance and non-finance stakeholders.
  • Ownership and Accountability: Demonstrates initiative, drives resolution to conclusion, and takes ownership of revenue cycle performance, accuracy, and process outcomes.
  • Integrity and Confidentiality: Handles sensitive financial, employee, and client information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Adaptability and Growth Orientation: Thrives in a fast-paced, evolving organization and can build, improve, and scale processes to support continued business growth.

Company Benefits:

After 90 days, full-time exempt employees will be eligible for health insurance, dental, vision, company paid life insurance, 401k, and unlimited PTO.

Totara is a global learning platform trusted by more than 1,500 organizations and 21 million users worldwide. We help organizations build workforce readiness through flexible learning, compliance, and talent development solutions designed to support complex and highly regulated environments across the public and private sectors.

We are looking for an IT Support Engineer to join Totara's internal IT team. You will pick up escalated issues from Tier 1, look after the systems our people use every day, and find ways to make IT simpler and faster for everyone.

IT support at Totara runs on a follow-the-sun model shared between the UK, New Zealand and the US. You will cover US hours, picking up work from the UK and handing over to New Zealand at the end of your day. We aim to help people get their work done rather than stand in their way, to automate repetitive tasks, and to keep security built in without making it a burden.

Main responsibilities

  • Handle escalations from Tier 1 and the service desk and see them through to resolution within agreed SLAs.
  • Lead the response to IT incidents in your region, including root-cause analysis and post-incident write-ups.
  • Cover US hours in our follow-the-sun support model, with clear handovers to the UK and New Zealand.
  • Administer Microsoft Entra ID, including users, groups, SSO integrations, Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Run joiner, mover and leaver processes, including lifecycle automation driven from HiBob.
  • Carry out regular access reviews.
  • Manage our macOS and Windows devices through IRU, Apple Business Manager and Intune, including configuration profiles, compliance policies, patching and app deployment.
  • Look after device provisioning, zero-touch enrolment, asset records and secure disposal.
  • Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint) and other SaaS tools, including licences and vendor support cases.
  • Automate manual work using PowerShell, shell scripting, Power Automate and APIs.
  • Help build and improve our conversational AI ticketing tooling.
  • Write and maintain knowledge base articles and runbooks.
  • Apply security baselines and fix issues raised by our endpoint, identity and vulnerability tools.
  • Provide evidence for audits and certifications such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 and Cyber Essentials, and support IT's work on FedRAMP.
  • Support IT project work, such as system migrations, new tool rollouts and process improvements.
  • Work with Engineering, People, Finance and Security to roll out new tools, including AI tools.

Skills and experience

  • IT support or engineering experience, including time working at second-line level.
  • Experience supporting staff across multiple regions, ideally in a SaaS or technology company.
  • Hands-on administration of a mixed macOS and Windows estate.
  • Microsoft Entra ID administration, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), Conditional Access and MFA.
  • Apple MDM (such as Jamf Pro, Kandji or IRU) and Intune in a production environment.
  • Microsoft 365 administration: Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint.
  • Scripting in PowerShell or Bash/zsh, with an example of a manual process you have automated.
  • Experience with Jira Service Management or a similar ITSM tool.
  • Good working knowledge of endpoint security, patching and least-privilege access.
  • Networking fundamentals, including office Wi-Fi, DNS and VPN troubleshooting.

Desirable

  • Experience of SaaS app migrations.
  • Apple Business Manager across multiple entities, and macOS scripting for MDM.
  • Microsoft Purview, Defender for Endpoint or Intune compliance reporting.
  • Python, Power Automate or REST API integrations.
  • Experience with conversational AI ticketing tools.
  • Audit and controls work for ISO 27001, SOC 2 or FedRAMP.
  • HiBob or other HR-system-driven provisioning.
  • Certifications such as MD-102, SC-300, MS-102, Apple Certified Support Professional, Jamf 100/200, ITIL 4 Foundation or CompTIA Security+.

Don't meet every essential criterion? Please apply anyway. If you have some of the experience above and a real interest in learning the rest, we would still like to hear from you.

About you

  • You enjoy helping people and can explain technical problems in plain language.
  • You look for a safe way to say yes to new tools and requests.
  • You are proactive with documentation, so anyone on the team can pick up where you left off.
  • You are comfortable working on your own and handing over clearly across time zones.
  • You are interested in automation and AI and keen to use them sensibly.
  • You want to keep learning, pick up new skills and grow with the team.

Benefits and Perks

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Enhanced Parental Leave
  • Professional Development Opportunities
  • Annual Wellbeing Allowance
  • New Joiner home working set-up allowance
  • Additional Paid Leave: Birthday off, Working days between Christmas and New Years Eve

Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is looking for a Data Architecture, Lead Associate.

This work is 100% remote.

This role builds and extends a greenfield data and AI platform supporting federal background investigation work. Working alongside the platform's lead engineer, you'll develop and maintain the pipelines, transformations, and data products that move the platform forward — growing your ownership as the platform matures. This is hands-on engineering in a high-trust environment where FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and CUI handling shape how the work is built.

Active clearance preferred; candidates able to obtain one encouraged to apply.

  • Monitor data quality, pipeline reliability, and performance; troubleshoot and resolve issues.
  • Apply data governance, cataloging, and access-control practices within the established framework.
  • Support the data science and ML team by delivering the governed datasets and tooling they need.
  • Operate within FedRAMP Moderate, NIST 800-171, and CUI constraints in day-to-day engineering.
  • Collaborate closely with the engineering team and maintain clear documentation of pipelines and processes.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. Citizenship required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a T5/SSBI federally adjudicated clearance; active clearance preferred.
  • 4 years building and maintaining production data pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Hands-on ETL / data pipeline development and sound analytical data modeling.
  • Working familiarity with cloud data platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP fine) and version control / CI/CD workflows.
  • Solid analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Government or defense contracting experience.
  • Familiarity with data governance / cataloging tooling (e.g., Unity
  • Catalog) and orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt).

Soft Skills

  • Dependable, self-directed execution with minimal oversight.
  • Strong collaboration across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Clear documentation and knowledge-sharing.
  • Eagerness to grow ownership and learn the compliance environment.

Keep Global Aviation Moving

At World Fuel, we support some of the world's most complex and demanding aviation operations. Every day, our team helps commercial, military, and business aviation customers execute missions across the globe by ensuring they have the permits, services, logistics, and operational support required for success.


As a Trip Support Specialist I, you will play a critical role in coordinating international flight operations and serving as a trusted partner to flight crews, operators, and customers worldwide. Whether supporting a business jet crossing multiple countries or assisting military and commercial flight operations, you'll help ensure every trip is executed safely, efficiently, and seamlessly.

Support international and domestic flight operations by arranging and managing:

  • Airport ground handling services
  • Landing and overflight permits
  • Airport slots and aircraft parking
  • Customs, immigration, and regulatory requirements
  • Hotel accommodations for flight crews
  • Ground transportation arrangements
  • Real-time flight following and operational updates

Deliver Outstanding Customer Service

  • Build strong relationships through proactive communication and operational expertise
  • Respond quickly to schedule changes, operational challenges, and customer requests
  • Ensure trips are executed accurately and efficiently from planning through completion
  • Provide solutions in time-sensitive situations while maintaining exceptional service standards

Manage Aviation Logistics

  • Create and maintain trip records within company operating systems
  • Prepare customer quotations, cost estimates, and operational documentation
  • Coordinate with airports, government agencies, international vendors, and service providers worldwide
  • Track trip progress and proactively communicate updates
  • Ensure accurate operational and billing documentation

Support Flight Planning Activities

Depending on the customer segment supported, responsibilities may include:

  • Assisting with flight planning and route analysis
  • Monitoring weather conditions and operational impacts
  • Providing weather briefing support
  • Utilizing flight planning platforms and aviation operational tools
  • Communicating route, permit, and operational requirements to customers and crews

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Aeronautics, Aviation Management, or a related field preferred
  • 0-2 years of aviation industry experience, or equivalent aviation education and training
  • Strong customer service and communication skills
  • Excellent organizational and time management abilities
  • High attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively within a team environment

Preferred Experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas is a plus:

  • Flight planning
  • Flight dispatch support
  • Airport operations
  • Business or corporate aviation
  • Commercial aviation operations
  • Military aviation operations
  • Global trip support
  • Aviation customer service
  • Weather briefing services

Technical Skills

Experience with any of the following is preferred:

  • PPS8
  • Air Inc.
  • Navblue
  • Microsoft Office Suite
  • Flight planning software
  • Aviation weather platforms
  • Aviation operational systems

What Makes You Successful

You are someone who:

  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast-paced operational environment
  • Enjoys solving complex logistical and operational challenges
  • Maintains composure and professionalism under pressure
  • Can effectively manage multiple trips and competing priorities simultaneously
  • Communicates clearly and confidently with customers and stakeholders
  • Builds strong working relationships across teams and time zones
  • Takes ownership of customer outcomes
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail and follow-through
  • Has a passion for aviation and global operations

Why Join World Fuel?

  • Work with commercial, military, and business aviation customers.

About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation.

Role overview

Every Hilo Band that reaches a customer on time is one more person who can start taking control of their blood pressure. As Logistics Manager you own our day- to- day D2C logistics execution end to end: Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada markets. That covers daily fulfilment and outbound logistics, inbound transportation from our factories to regional warehouses, last mile delivery, returns, and the daily relationship with our 3PLs and carriers. Our network has grown to six third party logistics partners worldwide, including our newest partner in the US. Your impact comes from running the operation superbly well every day, resolving issues before customers feel them, and steadily making the flows you own smoother, faster and more cost efficient. You contribute to our wider logistics strategy, while overall network architecture sits with Operations leadership. You work as an individual contributor without direct reports, in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service, with room to grow as the network scales.

Location: US-based, preferably East Coast, must be authorised to work in the United States, with regular traveling. The role requires minimum half-day working hours to overlap with our European-based team (CET), and travel to team and business events quarterly (or as needed).

Core responsibilities

End to end D2C logistics operations

  • Own end to end D2C logistics for Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada.
  • Run daily fulfilment and outbound logistics from order processing through final delivery, including last mile, returns and issue resolution.
  • Resolve exceptions fast and cleanly so customers never feel the friction behind the scenes.
  • Contribute to planning and implementing the overall logistics strategy.

3PL and carrier management

  • Manage and scale a multi 3PL network, including ramping up our newly launched US operation.
  • Own SLAs, performance reviews and capacity planning across logistics partners.
  • Be the daily operational contact for 3PLs and carriers, building relationships based on trust and clear expectations.

Inbound and international transportation

  • Own inbound transportation from our factories, for example in China and Vietnam, to regional warehouses.
  • Lead inbound carrier selection, route design, rate negotiation and cost to serve optimisation.
  • Coordinate freight booking, shipping schedules and handover to logistics partners.
  • Manage customs clearance processes and import documentation.

Product integrity and inventory execution

  • Ensure product integrity for devices that are sensitive to temperature, humidity and pressure.
  • Maintain inventory visibility across warehouses and sales channels.
  • Coordinate replenishment to avoid both stockouts and excess inventory.

Reporting and collaboration

  • Define and track logistics KPIs such as OTIF, lead time, cost per shipment and return rate, and report them so the business can act on them.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the operations you run.
  • Collaborate closely with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service.

Requirements

Background & Experience

Essential

  • 5+ years in logistics, fulfilment or supply chain operations, ideally in D2C or ecommerce and international distribution.
  • Proven experience managing 3PLs, carriers and cross border shipments.
  • Solid working knowledge of last mile delivery, Amazon fulfilment and international shipping fundamentals.
  • Hands on experience with logistics or ERP tools, and strong analytical skills.
  • Excellent English, written and spoken.
  • USA based, and willing to travel occasionally to warehouses in Switzerland, Germany, UK, Canada, Australia and the USA.

Nice to have

  • BSc in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field. Equivalent practical experience counts just as much.
  • Chinese.
  • Experience in medical device, pharmaceutical or other quality regulated logistics.
  • Experience setting up logistics operations in a new market.

How you work

  • You are a self starter who thrives in a scale up without a large support structure around you.
  • You have a strong execution mindset and real attention to detail.
  • You keep several issues moving in parallel and prioritise well under pressure.
  • You communicate clearly, take ownership and bring solutions rather than problems.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

  • Day 30 You know our network end to end: every 3PL, carrier, lane and system, and you are the go to person for daily operational questions.
  • Day 60 You run daily fulfilment and inbound execution independently, you have taken over the 3PL and carrier relationships, and you have named the three biggest sources of friction in the current flow.
  • Day 90 Logistics KPI reporting runs on your cadence, your first improvement is live and measurable, and you are driving the ramp up of our US operation.

After one year

  • Orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time, consistently and in Americas.
  • Operational issues are identified early and resolved before customers are affected.
  • Our US operation is running to SLA and scaling smoothly with demand.
  • Cost per shipment and inbound cost to serve are trending down with no trade off in service.
  • 3PLs and carriers experience us as a well run, well organised partner, and the customer delivery experience is consistently positive.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary range for this role is 125,000–140,000 USD, depending on experience and location, plus a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, and paid time off. In addition, we offer an attractive ESOP package, giving you the opportunity to participate in Hilo's long-term success and growth.

Why Join Us?

Hilo by Aktiia is becoming one of the most important med-tech companies, and you can be part of this exciting journey.

  • Work on a mission that matters - transforming cardiovascular health at global scale
  • Be part of a fast-growing, high-impact, venture-backed company
  • Collaborate with a diverse, passionate, and talented team

Ready to Move the Needle?

If you are excited about owning a market from the ground up, thrive in high-autonomy commercial leadership roles, and want to contribute to meaningful impact in healthcare, we would love to hear from you.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Hilo by Aktiia is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment.

raw.title: Work from home - Online English Teacher with YiYi
raw.excerpt: Teach English Online! • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing • Long-term employment only!
raw.description:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

raw.description:
Sales Partner – RealAdvisor (Mercado Español)

Buscamos vendedores con mentalidad de closer.

RealAdvisor es una de las principales plataformas digitales del ecosistema inmobiliario europeo. Fundada en Suiza, hoy apoyamos a más de 5.000 agencias inmobiliarias y llegamos a más de 10 millones de usuarios cada año en Europa.

Estamos acelerando nuestro crecimiento en el mercado español y buscamos Sales Partners freelance capaces de transformar oportunidades comerciales en clientes.

No es necesario conocer el sector inmobiliario: te formaremos en el producto y en el mercado. Lo que buscamos es una demostrada capacidad de venta y de cierre.

El resultado que buscamos

Nuestro objetivo es construir un equipo de vendedores capaces de alcanzar al menos 15 ventas al mes.

Para los profesionales que alcanzan un alto rendimiento, el plan de comisiones ofrece un potencial de ingresos superior a 20.000 € al mes, en función de los resultados obtenidos.

El principio es simple: cuanto más vendes, más ganas.

Tu rol

Tendrás la responsabilidad de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta la firma del contrato. No buscamos personas especializadas exclusivamente en prospecting o en demos. Buscamos full-cycle sales, capaces de gestionar de forma autónoma una negociación de principio a fin.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

  • Prospecting outbound y generación autónoma de oportunidades
  • Gestión de leads inbound
  • Gestión de reuniones cualificadas proporcionadas por nuestro equipo de SDR
  • Cualificación de prospects
  • Demos comerciales por videoconferencia
  • Análisis de necesidades del cliente
  • Presentación de la solución y propuesta de valor
  • Gestión de objeciones y negociación
  • Seguimiento estructurado
  • Envío y gestión del contrato
  • Cierre de la venta
  • Gestión completa del pipeline en el CRM

En resumen: del primer contacto a la firma.

Un rol de alta intensidad comercial

Es importante ser claros sobre el ritmo de trabajo requerido.

El rol prevé indicativamente 5 demos al día, generalmente a través de videollamadas de 20 a 40 minutos.

A estas actividades se suman el prospecting, el seguimiento, la negociación y la gestión del pipeline. Parte de las reuniones estará organizada por nuestro equipo de SDR, pero esperamos que el Sales Partner sea capaz de generar nuevas oportunidades por sí mismo.

Requirements

Requisitos (Quién buscamos)

No se requiere experiencia previa en el sector inmobiliario, pero es fundamental tener experiencia concreta en venta B2B/outbound.

Buscamos profesionales que:

  • Tengan experiencia previa en roles comerciales y venta outbound.
  • Sepan realizar demos comerciales efectivas por videollamada.
  • Dominen la gestión de objeciones, la negociación y el cierre de contratos.
  • Estén acostumbrados a trabajar por objetivos y KPIs.
  • Tengan mentalidad emprendedora, autonomía y disciplina.
  • Tengan experiencia en el uso de herramientas CRM.
  • Cuenten con español nativo o fluido (C1/C2).

No buscamos simplemente un comercial: buscamos un closer.

Benefits

Qué ofrecemos

  • Potencial de ingresos de 20.000 €+ al mes para perfiles de alto rendimiento (contamos con compañeros que superan de forma estable los 30.000 €/mes).
  • Plan de comisiones fuertemente orientado a resultados.
  • Reuniones cualificadas facilitadas por el equipo SDR.
  • Formación completa sobre el producto y el sector inmobiliario.
  • Colaboración freelance a largo plazo.
  • Apoyo continuo de un equipo internacional.
  • Mercado español en fuerte expansión.

Tipo de colaboración

  • Modalidad: Freelance / Autónomo (facturación mensual a nuestra sede en Suiza).
  • Dedicación: Al menos 35 horas semanales.
  • Remuneración: Basada en rendimiento y comisiones por venta.

Overview

The Project Manager – Payment owns delivery of defined project(s) from initiation through close. Ensures plans are realistic, stakeholders are aligned, execution stays on track, and risks/issues are actively managed.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs, and status reporting.
  • Facilitate team meetings, decisions, issue resolution, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Coordinate scope, schedule, resources, communications, and delivery readiness.
  • Escalate risks and tradeoffs in a timely manner.
  • Ensure project artifacts, governance requirements, and documentation are complete.
  • Owns one project’s scope, timeline, and execution discipline.
  • Utilize AI responsibly, to amplify productivity to draft status reports, maintain RAID logs, generate meeting notes and action items, build project plans, and prepare stakeholder communications.
  • Share best practices with project managers, product owners, business analysts as appropriate.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues, and escalate in a timely manner.
  • Key Interfaces -
    • Program Managers
    • PMO Analyst
    • Business stakeholders
    • Product
    • R&D
    • Operations
    • Vendors (if applicable)
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 5+ years of project management experience required.
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent).
  • Experience running cross-functional projects with disciplined status, RAID, and timeline management.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with healthcare operations, software delivery, or business transformation preferred.
  • Agile and waterfall delivery methods.
  • Smartsheet/Jira/PM tooling.
  • Project planning.
  • Schedule management.
  • Issue resolution.
  • Meeting facilitation.
  • Stakeholder communication.
  • Execution discipline.
  • Attention to detail.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
  • Maintaining focus.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $100,000 to $135,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Inizio Engage has a long-standing partnership with a leading Biotechnology company, across Commercial, Patient Solutions and Medical Affairs businesses.


The Virtual Field Access Manager will provide access education to HCPs of insured patients who enroll in vendor programs and/or have been prescribed one of our client’s brands. They will engage healthcare providers, and their staff to communicate and educate on patient benefit coverage, prior authorization processes, general payer policy criteria and affordability programs supporting the initiation of the products. They will have a solid understanding of the local, regional and national payer landscape. Exceptional customer and patient engagement skills, attention to detail, and the ability to think comprehensively is a must. The virtual Field Access Manager will report to a National Director.


This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent Genentech, a top biotechnology company!


Why You’ll Love Working Here

We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

  • Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
  • Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
  • Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
  • Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
  • Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
  • A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

  • Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
  • Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more:


What you will be doing?

  • Engage healthcare providers and appropriate office staff to educate on access to prescribed treatments within the specialty pharmacy channel, including addressing questions about initial access, insurance approval and reauthorizations pertaining to the initiation of product.
  • Educate HCP office staff about prior authorization & appeals process, how to access related forms, and high-level information about submission procedures and reauthorization requirements.
  • Formulate and implement comprehensive educational framework to upskill field partners including Clinical Specialists and District Managers on navigating simple to moderately complex access challenges.
  • Work compliantly and proactively to identify and resolve patient access and reimbursement issues, within assigned geography.
  • Provide appropriate factual process information to HCP office utilizing Personal Health Information (PHI), with appropriate patient consent.
  • Serve as reimbursement expert for patient support services team for assigned geography/plans
  • Utilize approved resources and call guides/FAQs to provide education and answer questions as needed.
  • Conduct ongoing payer policy reviews and contribute local, regional and national policy insights to key stakeholders and client leadership.
  • Virtually manage assigned accounts and align with key stakeholders on ongoing support needs.
  • Document call details with attention to data integrity to ensure compliance with program policies and business rules.
  • Navigate CRM platform in daily interactions and learn internal team processes.
  • Maintain confidentiality of Patient Health Information (PHI) and act in compliance with all laws, regulations, and company policies.
  • Triage appropriate escalations to the manufacturer leadership team in accordance with the program design and business rules.
  • Comply, take, and attend all required training. Adhere to all Inizio and client policies, procedures, business rules, and call guides, as well as applicable laws.

What do you need for this position?

  • BS/BA Degree
  • Proven success operating in a virtual environment
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in reimbursement and patient access, market access, specialty pharmacy, or physician/system account management, with 5+ years of total healthcare industry experience.
  • Experience engaging HCP staff in a support role to educate on access pathways and product requirements
  • Experience navigating payer reimbursement process, including commercial and Medicare Part D (pharmacy benefit design and coverage policy)
  • Ophthalmology and self-injectable experience preferred
  • Experience with specialty products acquired through specialty pharmacy networks
  • Patient-centric and service-oriented mindset, with a high degree of emotional intelligence and empathy
  • Exemplary interpersonal and listening skills
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), and presentation skills
  • Strong business acumen
  • High enthusiasm with a drive to success within a team – demonstrated ability to reach common goals in collaboration with multiple therapeutic specialists, sales leadership, market access, and patient support services colleagues
  • Highly organized with excellent attention to detail and the ability to multi-task in engaging both patients and providers
  • Highly proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Google Suite Products
  • Language requirements: English required and Spanish highly preferred

The base pay range for this position is $ 98K – $ 182K per year. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.


About Inizio Engage


Inizio Engage is a strategic, commercial, and creative engagement partner that specializes in healthcare. Our passionate, global workforce augments local expertise and diverse mix of skills with data, science, and technology to deliver bespoke engagement solutions that help clients reimagine how they engage with their patients, payers, people, and providers to improve treatment outcomes. Our mission is to partner with our clients, improving lives by helping healthcare professionals and patients get the medicines, knowledge and support they need.

We believe in our values: We empower everyone/We rise to the challenge/We work as one/We ask what if/We do the right thing, and we will ask you how your personal values align to them.

To learn more about Inizio Engage, visit us at:

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion


Inizio Engage is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, gender, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related conditions), mental or physical disability, national origin, protected family care or medical leave status, race, religion (including beliefs and practices or the absence thereof), sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Inizio Engage is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in accordance with applicable law.

Inizio Engage complies with applicable fair chance hiring laws and will consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal history. Where permitted by applicable law, employment offers may be contingent upon the successful completion of a background check. Any information obtained from a background check will be considered in relation to the requirements of the relevant position, consistent with applicable law.

Candidate Use of Artificial Intelligence in Interviews


As part of our commitment to a fair and equitable hiring process, candidates are expected to complete all interview activities without the use of artificial intelligence tools or external assistance unless such assistance is authorized in advance by Inizio Engage or otherwise required in accordance with applicable law. This includes, but is not limited to, using generative artificial intelligence platforms to produce, edit, or guide responses in real time. Candidates may be asked to confirm compliance with this policy. Any violation of this policy may result in disqualification from consideration of employment. 🏢 About the Client

Our client is an established US-based commercial construction firm specializing in bidding on and executing mid-to-large-scale commercial projects. With a long-standing reputation in the industry, the company relies on strong trade/subcontractor relationships, precise project timing, and rigorous bid evaluations to sustain steady business growth.

💼 About the Role

As Executive Assistant and Operations Coordinator, you will act as the CEO's primary operational partner and "right hand." Working alongside Inside Out’s integration framework, this role goes beyond traditional admin work. You will manage pre-construction bid pipelines, streamline executive communications using AI tools, maintain operational SOPs, and protect the CEO's focus time.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

🏗️ 1. Bid & Pipeline Management (Primary Focus)

  • Daily Bid Board Monitoring: Review subscribed bid boards daily to identify, screen, and flag matching commercial opportunities early. (Checking daily is critical—missing a day means missing bids).

  • Bid Log Maintenance: Own, update, and maintain the central bid log in real-time, ensuring all active opportunities, statuses, submission dates, and outcomes are accurately tracked for the team.

  • Walkthrough & Deadline Scheduling: Coordinate and log mandatory bid walkthroughs, site visits, and submission deadlines without overlap.

  • Spec & Folder Organization: Compile specification documents, architectural plans, and bid packages into clean, structured project folders.

  • Subcontractor Compliance & Risk Management: Track and verify subcontractor compliance documents—such as Certificates of Insurance (COIs), W-9s, and signed subcontracts—to ensure the firm meets legal and project requirements before work begins.

  • Change Order & Project Tracking: Maintain change order logs, track Requests for Information (RFIs), and update project status spreadsheets to keep the pipeline transparent and organized.

📧 2. Inbox & Communication

  • Inbox Triage: Monitor and clear the owner's inbox daily, flagging urgent items and maintaining clear communication.

  • Drafting Replies: Draft inquiry responses, vendor updates, and follow-ups in the owner’s voice.

  • Subcontractor Coordination: Handle routine back-and-forth communication with trade partners, suppliers, and subcontractors.

🤖 3. AI & Operational Support

  • AI Tool Integration: Use AI tools (specifically Google Gemini, ChatGPT, or Claude) daily as a thinking partner to evaluate spec documents, review proposals, and draft correspondence faster.

  • Workflow & Deadline Tracking: Maintain a clear, live view of active bids, due dates, and outstanding action items.

  • SOP & Process Documentation: Keep internal bidding workflows, daily procedures, and administrative routines documented and organized.

  • Executive & Life Admin: Safeguard the owner's calendar for site visits and high-level decision-making, helping with general administrative needs as requested.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • Communication (Non-Negotiable): Flawless written and spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand voice and minimal accent for professional client and vendor calls.

  • Tech & AI Savvy: Proficient in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Drive) and comfortable leveraging generative AI tools (Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude) to increase daily productivity.

  • Detail & Deadline Driven: Exceptional organization skills with acute awareness of strict bid deadlines, mandatory meetings, and document accuracy.

  • Construction Familiarity: Strong understanding of standard construction documentation (such as blueprints, architectural specs, addenda, and RFIs) to help hit the ground running.

  • Problem Solver: A self-starter who brings solutions and proactive updates rather than needing step-by-step direction.

🌟 Bonus Points:
