Overview

We are seeking a highly driven Regional Vice President, Sales - Legal IT Infrastructure to partner with our exec team and double-down on our expansion into the Legal Managed IT Services market.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing contracts with law firms ranging from boutique practices to the AmLaw 100 and 200. You will not just be selling traditional IT helpdesk support; you will act as a strategic consultant, positioning our organization as a critical partner in cloud migration, cybersecurity, compliance readiness, and artificial intelligence (AI) integration. Position reports to the VP of Legal IT Infrastructure.

Qualified candidates will have 5+ years of proven success in B2B technology sales, specifically within Managed IT Services (MSP), cloud architecture, cybersecurity, or legal enterprise software (SaaS). Ideal candidates are located in NYC or Boston. Must have confidence in network and ability to close business within 6 months of hire.

About Us

IST Management is a business process outsourcing company. Founded in 1997, we have over 1,800 employees and operations across the U.S. We provide a range of services geared toward litigation and corporate office support including e-Discovery processing and hosting, court reporting, digital forensic collections, managed review, and managed services. IST Management is a Relativity Certified Provider and tool-agnostic. We also provide a full range of facilities management and office services.

We’ve been recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. as a winner of the Nation’s Best & Brightest Companies to Work For, as well as the HR Professional Excellence Award from the Society for Human Resource Management. We are proud to belong to the Military Spouse Employment Partnership through our nation’s Department of Defense and have committed to Hiring Our Heroes’ mission to hire 100,000 active and former service members. IST Management has also been included in the INC 5000 list!

Check us out at istmanagement.com for more information.

Compensation

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

3% on equipment sales revenue

5% on services sales revenue

OTE Y1 225K+

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, Life, 401k, Bonus incentives, Seven paid holidays and 23 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year accrued at a rate of 3.54 hours/wk

This is a full-time remote role, but with travel expectations for establishing and maintaining client relationships - including air travel. This is an outside sales position.

Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Generation & Full-Cycle Sales: Prospect and secure new business by targeting law firm Managing Partners, Chief Operating Officers (COOs), and IT Directors who require enterprise-grade IT infrastructure and white-glove service desk support.
  • Strategic Needs Assessment: Conduct consultative sales meetings to uncover a firm's vulnerabilities, focusing on the high cost of operational downtime, remote work infrastructure, and the necessity of rapid ticket resolution.
  • Compliance & Cybersecurity Positioning: Articulate the value of our robust security offerings, positioning our Virtual Chief Information Security Officer (vCISO) services, SOC 2 readiness, and alignment with frameworks like HIPAA, SEC, and CMMC to help law firms pass stringent corporate client audits.
  • Application Ecosystem Consulting: Speak fluently about the legal software ecosystem, successfully conveying our ability to manage and integrate core business applications like Document Management Systems (iManage, NetDocuments) and Practice Management platforms (Elite 3E, Clio, Aderant).
  • Industry Networking & Thought Leadership: Actively participate in the International Legal Technology Association (ILTA) ecosystem, leveraging business partner sponsorships, attending ILTACON, and engaging with the community to generate enterprise leads and build institutional credibility.
  • AI Integration Advisory: Capitalize on the legal industry's transition toward generative AI by selling our services as a secure, ethically compliant conduit for integrating AI agents into a firm's existing data environment without compromising client confidentiality.
  • Adhere to all company and safety standards

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of proven success in B2B technology sales, specifically within Managed IT Services (MSP), cloud architecture, cybersecurity, or legal enterprise software (SaaS). Ability to close business within first 6 months of employment.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of the legal industry's unique operational pressures, including the billable hour model, ethical obligations regarding data sovereignty, and the specific demands of litigation timelines
  • Technical Fluency: Ability to confidently discuss complex IT concepts, including Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI), Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR/MDR), Microsoft 365 migrations, and Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) strategies
  • Relationship Building: Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that involve highly skeptical and analytical decision-makers
  • Communication: Exceptional presentation and proposal-writing skills, capable of translating highly technical IT infrastructure benefits into clear, risk-mitigating business outcomes for legal executives
  • Legal Authorization to work for any employer in the US; diploma or GED

Preferred Qualifications

  • Existing network of contacts within law firm administration or the Association of Legal Administrators (ALA)
  • Familiarity with the specific pain points of legacy legal software and on-premise server migrations

If you require any accommodation in completing your application for employment, please let us know by informing our Talent Acquisition team at .

Please respect individuals reaching out for accommodations by utilizing the contact information only for this purpose. You will receive correspondence directly from your local IST Management hiring team regarding your application submission and status after submission.

Beta Systems International is seeking an experienced independent consultant to support the Church Engagement team of a major U.S.-based Catholic international humanitarian organization. This is a short, high-impact engagement of roughly 100 hours over about eight weeks starting in December (an average of 12–13 hours per week, flexible around the holidays). You will be the named lead consultant on the engagement, working directly with the team’s director and staff.

What You Will Do

Salesforce and data systems
  • Develop a consistent nomenclature guide for entering engagements into Salesforce, and train and support team members in using it.
  • Build Salesforce reports for different areas of work and a monitoring dashboard aligned with team objectives and key activities.
  • Finalize and test a reporting tool for partners.
  • Provide ongoing data entry, data quality control and assurance.
Microsoft Teams and team operations
  • Redesign the team’s MS Teams file architecture to reflect current priorities.
  • Develop a practical structure and process guide for managing collaborative team work, including calendaring.
Strategy and measurement
  • Facilitate development of team-wide OKRs for the next quarter and set up a simple way to monitor them.
  • Design a monthly team progress review meeting, write its facilitation guide, and facilitate the first session(s) to review results and capture learning.

What You Bring

Required
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience: building reports and dashboards, defining data entry standards, and cleaning data (Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience preferred).
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365, especially Teams, SharePoint and Outlook calendaring, plus web conferencing tools.
  • Experience leading strategy and measurement work: OKRs or similar goal frameworks, MEAL (monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning), and data analysis.
  • Proven facilitation skills with small teams, in person and virtually.
  • In-depth knowledge of the Catholic Church in the United States and Catholic Social Teaching.
  • Demonstrated project management skills: you deliver clear, usable products on tight timelines.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills; comfortable training non-technical colleagues.
Preferred
  • Prior consulting work with Catholic dioceses, parishes, or faith-based nonprofits.
  • Experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud / NPSP or Experience Cloud partner reporting.
  • A prior assignment you can point to that combined data systems, strategy and operations support.

Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor (1099); you provide your own equipment.
  • Availability of 10–15 hours per week from December 1, 2026 through January 29, 2027, including some availability in the December 15–30 window.
  • You must be able to provide two professional references, at least one for similar systems, strategy or operations work.

Description

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company, providing high-end consulting and incident response support for organizations worldwide. We work with companies to proactively build their cyber resilience and to respond to and defeat attacks within their networks. Sygnia is the trusted advisor and cybersecurity service provider for IT and security teams, senior managements, and boards of leading organizations around the world, including Fortune 100 companies.

Our team combines top talent from elite military technology units and across the cyber industry. We bring technological expertise, digital combat experience, data analytics and a business-driven mindset to cybersecurity, enabling organizations to thrive in the face of cyber threats.

The Role

We are looking for an Advanced Monitoring Expert to join our team of cybersecurity analysts. In this role, you will conduct advanced and tailored monitoring activities in post-breach client environments. You will develop detection analyses, triage alerts, investigate security incidents, and perform proactive threat hunting. The role also involves onboarding new clients, working closely with incident response teams, and enhancing visibility and detection capabilities.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in dynamic environments, has strong problem-solving skills, and thrives when collaborating with clients and teammates.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform post-breach monitoring in client environments, including triage of alerts and host forensics analysis.
  • Develop custom detection and analysis methods to monitor client environments, often based on known threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Support major incident response engagements by delivering accurate detection when active threats are suspected.
  • Maintain visibility and log forwarding across endpoints, cloud environments, and network devices.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting using host- and network-based analysis, malware hunting, and IOC searches.
  • Create automation tools and capabilities for alert triage, escalation, visibility management, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with client security teams, providing regular updates and follow-ups on alerts and security events.
  • Generate reports and metrics on incidents, trends, visibility status, and response procedures.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity roles within SOC, SecOps, or security monitoring environments.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong understanding of the lifecycle of advanced security threats, attack vectors, and exploitation techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM tools such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Exabeam.
  • Knowledge of common data and log sources for detection and analysis, including Event Logs, Firewalls, and EDR tools.
  • Technical understanding of network fundamentals, common Internet protocols, and security controls.
  • Familiarity of host-based forensics and OS artifacts.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, web applications, or servers is a plus.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills.
  • Willingness to work outside normal hours and travel occasionally.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience developing custom detection logic or automation workflows.
  • Previous involvement in incident response or digital forensics investigations.
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms or red-team engagements.
  • Security certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, or OSCP.

Why Sygnia

At Sygnia, you will work alongside some of the most talented professionals in the cybersecurity industry. We offer the opportunity to solve complex security challenges for global organizations while continuing to grow your expertise. Our culture values innovation, teamwork, and professional growth, making Sygnia an exciting place to build your career.

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company that partners with organizations around the world to proactively strengthen their cyber resilience and respond to advanced threats. Our services include strategic cybersecurity consulting, incident response, proactive security assessments, and Managed Detection and Response (MDR). Sygnia works with leading global enterprises, including Fortune 100 companies, across industries such as financial services, healthcare, technology, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure.

With a team composed of elite cybersecurity professionals from military and commercial backgrounds, Sygnia delivers precision, speed, and impact when it matters most.

The Role

Sygnia is seeking a Cyber Security Consultant to join our growing Enterprise Security team in the United States. This is a highly technical consulting role focused on helping organizations assess, strengthen, and mature their cybersecurity programs through proactive security assessments and strategic advisory engagements.

You will work alongside some of the industry's leading cybersecurity experts to evaluate enterprise environments, identify security risks, and provide practical recommendations that improve security posture across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid infrastructures.

This is primarily a delivery-focused consulting role. Client relationship ownership is managed by Engagement Managers, allowing you to focus on delivering exceptional technical work while partnering closely with internal teams to ensure successful client outcomes.

Experience with Operational Technology (OT) and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) environments is highly valued as Sygnia continues expanding its capabilities across critical infrastructure and industrial sectors, though it is not required.

  • Experience performing Operational Technology (OT) or Industrial Control Systems (ICS) security assessments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a structured, consultative approach.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating across cross-functional technical teams.

Bonus Points For

Why Sygnia

About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund.

Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we’re building for:
Watch here:

About the Client

A venture-backed virtual pediatric care company is looking for a Revenue Cycle Management Specialist to run day-to-day billing operations and keep insurance reimbursement and patient payments flowing on time.

The company delivers virtual, multi-specialty care for children with chronic conditions such as ADHD and anxiety, with referrals coming from pediatricians across multiple US states. It is in-network with major commercial insurers, serves both commercial and Medicaid families, and recently raised a Series A to expand into new care areas.

About the Role

The RCM Specialist owns the revenue cycle from insurance verification and claims submission through payment posting, claims follow-up, denials, and patient collections, reporting to the Team Lead. The role works directly with patients, families, payers, and internal teams to resolve billing and reimbursement issues. Success means clean claims, faster reimbursement, fewer repeat denials, and a clear billing experience for families.

Core Responsibilities

Eligibility & Benefits Verification

  • Verify insurance eligibility and benefits before visits, before claim submission, and during follow-up.
  • Confirm copays, deductibles, coinsurance, out-of-pocket maximums, and in-network status.
  • Investigate inactive policies, coverage limits, and discrepancies.
  • Document verification results accurately in designated systems.

Claims Submission

  • Validate demographics, insurance details, CPT and ICD-10 codes, modifiers, and place of service before submission.
  • Submit claims within payer timely filing requirements.
  • Monitor clearinghouse and payer acknowledgments, and correct and resubmit rejected claims.
  • Route coding questions to the designated reviewer.

Payment Posting

  • Post insurance payments, adjustments, and denials from ERAs and EOBs.
  • Post patient payments according to billing and collection procedures.
  • Reconcile posted payments against deposits and remittance totals.
  • Flag underpayments and overpayments against expected reimbursement.

Claims Follow-up, Denials & Appeals

  • Follow up on unpaid, pending, and underpaid claims through payer portals.
  • Identify denial root causes and complete corrections, resubmissions, reconsiderations, and appeals.
  • Track denial trends and recovery outcomes, and flag recurring payer, coding, or eligibility issues.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved claims to the Team Lead.

Patient Billing & Collections

  • Explain coverage, benefits, and expected costs to patients and families based on verified benefits.
  • Conduct outreach on outstanding copays, coinsurance, deductibles, and self-pay balances.
  • Set up payment arrangements within approved guidelines.
  • Respond to billing inquiries by phone, email, and patient portal.

Documentation & Quality

  • Document all RCM activity in designated systems following SOPs, payer guidelines, and HIPAA requirements.
  • Meet assigned productivity, quality, and turnaround-time targets.
  • Recommend workflow improvements based on recurring billing issues.

Requirements

Must-Have

  • 2+ years of hands-on US healthcare revenue cycle or medical billing experience
  • Hands-on experience across eligibility and benefits verification, claims submission, payment posting, claims follow-up, and denial management
  • Working knowledge of US commercial insurance and Medicaid, including copays, deductibles, coinsurance, and network status
  • Working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, and modifiers for claim review and validation
  • Payment posting from ERAs and EOBs, including adjustments, denials, and deposit reconciliation
  • Hands-on use of payer portals, clearinghouses, and billing platforms, with HIPAA-compliant handling of PHI
  • English at C1+ CEFR level for live patient, family, and payer calls

Nice-to-Have

  • CPB or CRCR certification
  • Experience with Medicaid managed care plans
  • Hands-on experience with a practice management or EHR system
  • Pediatric, behavioral health, or telehealth billing experience
  • Spanish fluency for patient and family outreach

Benefits

  • Remote Work: Fully remote—work from anywhere
  • Team Incentives: Recognition for maintaining 100% CRM hygiene and on-time reporting
  • Generous PTO: In accordance with company policy

  • Direct Mentorship: Guidance from international industry experts
  • Learning & Development: Ongoing access to resources for professional growth
  • Global Networking: Connect with professionals worldwide

raw.description:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools.

Now is the time to join! Here's why:

  • Build out our detection and response function. Liftoff has a mature security information and event management platform (SIEM), established detection content, and a working incident response program. Your charter is to take it to the next level — including leading our investment in AI-augmented SOC tooling.
  • High visibility, high impact. Detection and response is a critical capability for Liftoff.
  • Security-conscious engineering culture. Liftoff's engineering org is a willing and capable partner on security work.
  • Hands-on technical work. Stay deep in code, detections, and incidents.
  • Breadth of work. Detection and response is the primary focus, but you'll partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security where the work demands it.
  • Large-scale, interesting systems. Liftoff processes millions of requests per second across its demand-side platform (DSP), mobile software development kit (SDK), and ad exchange.

Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day operation of Liftoff's SIEM (Panther) — log source ingestion, detection content, and the alert investigation pipeline.
  • Lead Liftoff's adoption of AI-augmented SOC tooling (e.g. Prophet, Dropzone, or equivalent) as a multi-year modernization investment.
  • Triage incoming security alerts and drive timely investigation and remediation with stakeholders across Engineering and IT.
  • Lead incident response — investigation, containment, and post-incident review — and mature processes and runbooks so response becomes predictable and repeatable.
  • Build tooling and automation that detects active threats, enriches alerts, and reduces manual investigation toil.
  • Partner with Engineering and IT to make detection and response self-service where possible — clear log-onboarding paths, documented detection proposals, accessible runbooks — so security scales without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Close the feedback loop between the team's offensive and proactive findings and detection coverage.
  • Partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security work alongside your detection and response focus — every engineer on this team covers breadth beyond their primary focus.
  • Participate in the Security team's on-call rotation and incident response.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in security engineering, security operations, detection engineering, or software engineering with a security focus.
  • Hands-on production SIEM operation — onboarding log sources, writing and maintaining detection content, and triaging alerts.
  • Write production-quality code for security automation and detection-as-code.
  • Experience leading or substantially contributing to security incident response.
  • Strong technical writing — design docs, runbooks, and post-incident reviews.
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing security work using a risk-based approach.
  • Ability to quickly navigate large, unfamiliar codebases and reason about complex engineering systems.
  • Excellent verbal communication.
  • Willing to participate in an on-call rotation.

Desirable Qualifications:

  • Hands-on experience with an AI-augmented SOC platform (Prophet Security, Dropzone AI, or equivalent), or with building large language model (LLM) augmented investigation and runbook tooling.
  • Experience operating in cloud environments at scale.
  • Cloud incident response experience, particularly in AWS.
  • Endpoint forensics for incident response on Mac and/or Linux.
  • Detection-as-code workflows in continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Mobile adtech or high-volume SaaS background.

Compensation:

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, NYC, Seattle: $200,000 - $250,000 plus bonus
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $184,000 - $220,000 plus bonus

Location:

This role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA.

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

raw.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Canada

New Sales Business | Walnut Insurance | Remote, Canada | Reports to the COO

The role

You'll bring in Walnut's next enterprise partners in Canada, and you'll start with the relationships you already have. This is a pure new-business role. You source your own leads, open the doors, qualify hard, and convert the right ones into signed partners on both sides of our platform: distribution partners such as banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos and consumer brands that should be offering insurance inside their products, and insurance carriers looking for new embedded distribution. You'll run your own territory, plan and pipeline with very little oversight. You'll report directly to our COO and work alongside our founders, who still sell with the team. Once a partner signs, our account management and implementation teams take it from there, so your time goes on finding and winning the next one.

About Walnut

Walnut is Canada's leading embedded insurance platform. Partners like Wealthsimple, BMO, KOHO and TELUS use us to launch insurance inside their products in 90 days, compared with nine months or more going direct to a carrier. We hold the carrier relationships, the licenses and the compliance; our partners keep the customer. We're nationally licensed in P&C and life and health across every province, including Quebec.

What you'll do

  • Source your own leads. Start with your network, then build out from it. Work your contacts, referrals, events, associations and outbound to create a steady flow of conversations with decision-makers at Canadian financial institutions, telcos, digital brands and insurance carriers. Nobody hands you a lead list. You build the pipeline.

  • Open doors at the senior level. Get meetings with the people who can say yes: heads of product, partnerships, digital, lending and insurance at distribution partners, and heads of distribution, partnerships and product at carriers. Use warm introductions wherever you have them, and cold outreach that gets answered where you don't.

  • Qualify fast and manage the pipeline. Separate real opportunities from interest early. Keep every lead, contact and next step current in HubSpot, and run a forecast you'd stand behind in front of the board.

  • Convert. Run discovery, build the business case for an embedded program, and take deals through proposal, security review, procurement and legal to signature. Our solutioning, legal and carrier teams back you along the way.

  • Hand off and move on. Pass signed partners to account management and implementation with a clear scope, then go back to sourcing.

  • Run yourself. Set your own territory plan, activity targets and priorities. Report progress weekly and flag what you need before it slows a deal.

  • Bring back what you hear in market. Tell us which segments are buying, which messages land and which products prospects keep asking for.

What you bring

  • A real Canadian network. You have relationships you can call this week at banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos, large consumer brands or insurance carriers. We'll ask you to show us where.

  • Seven or more years in B2B sales or business development, with a track record of sourcing and closing new enterprise business yourself, not inheriting it.

  • Proven lead-to-close skill. You can show us pipeline you built from nothing, how it converted, and the revenue it produced.

  • A self-starter who doesn't need managing. You've worked as a one-person team or the first seller in a market and built your own momentum.

  • Comfort with long, complex cycles of six to twelve months or more, with several stakeholders and procurement, legal and compliance review.

  • Commercial fluency. You can talk about premium, commission, attach rate and partner economics with a CFO, a head of product or a carrier's head of distribution. Insurance, creditor insurance, payments or banking-SaaS experience is a strong plus.

  • AI as part of how you sell. You use tools like Claude, and HubSpot to research prospects, personalize outreach and prep for meetings.

  • Bilingual in English and French is a strong asset for Quebec and national accounts.

Your first 90 days

By day 30, you know our products, partners and carriers, have mapped your network against our target segments with the COO, and are booking first meetings. By day 60, you've held at least ten senior conversations and moved three or more into active opportunities. By day 90, you have [$X] of qualified pipeline in HubSpot that you sourced yourself, and at least one deal at proposal stage.

How to apply

Send us three things:

  1. Your resume and a link to your LinkedIn profile.

  2. A short cover letter about an enterprise deal you sourced and closed yourself. Tell us how you found it, who you knew, what nearly killed it, and the outcome.

  3. Ten Canadian organizations (distribution partners, carriers or both) you could get a meeting with in your first 60 days, with the role of the person you'd call at each. Names aren't required at this stage.

Our process includes a review of your past pipeline and results, a conversation about your network, and a mock first meeting with a real Walnut target.

What we offer

A base salary of CAD $110,000 - $150,000 based on background and experience, plus commission under Walnut's sales compensation plan, equity and benefits. Fully remote in Canada, with travel to prospect meetings and industry events. You'll report directly to the COO at a scaling fintech.

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

About the Role:Walmart is building the AI-powered future of commerce and enterprise. We are seeking a Senior Director of Partnerships Strategy and Operations to help define where and how strategic partnerships create the greatest value for Walmart, while building the operating system that enables the Partnerships team to execute at scale.
This leader will shape new-product and partnership strategy, lead the team’s data-governance strategy, and build the planning, measurement, and operating rhythms that connect strategy to execution. Working at the intersection of Product, Global Technology, Data, and commercial strategy, you will turn external insight and internal priorities into clear choices, actionable plans, and measurable outcomes.
What You’ll Do:New Product and Partnership Strategy:
  • Define and lead strategic analyses that identify where new products, capabilities, and partnerships can accelerate Walmart’s customer, enterprise, and growth priorities.
  • Develop partnership theses, opportunity roadmaps, and executive-ready recommendations that clarify customer value, strategic fit, investment requirements, risks, and buy, build, or partner implications.
  • Partner with Product and Global Technology leaders to translate long-range roadmaps into partnership priorities, decision frameworks, and actionable workplans.
  • Assess emerging opportunities and help prioritize the team’s investment of time, capital, and executive attention across a rapidly changing technology landscape.

Market Research and Intelligence:
  • Build and lead a market-intelligence capability that provides timely, decision-useful insight on market trends, technology shifts, competitors, potential partners, and adjacent business models.
  • Synthesize external research, partner input, customer and business signals, and internal data into clear points of view for senior leadership.
  • Develop repeatable approaches for market mapping, partner landscape assessment, competitive analysis, and early identification of strategic opportunities and risks.
  • Create concise executive communications that turn complex information into decisions, recommendations, and next steps.

Data Governance and Value Measurement:
  • Define the Partnerships team’s data-governance strategy, including the standards, taxonomy, ownership, and processes needed to maintain a trusted view of the partnership portfolio.
  • Establish consistent measurement frameworks that connect partnerships to strategic, financial, product, technology, and operational outcomes.
  • Partner with Data, Finance, Legal, Privacy, and Global Technology to ensure partnership data is accurate, appropriately governed, and usable for decision-making and performance management.
  • Develop dashboards and executive reporting that make portfolio health, value realization, risks, dependencies, and decisions visible and actionable.

Partnership Operations and Execution:
  • Design and continuously improve the Partnerships operating model, including annual planning, portfolio reviews, governance forums, executive updates, and cross-functional engagement rhythms.
  • Build scalable processes and tools for opportunity intake, prioritization, partner lifecycle management, decision tracking, value realization, and risk escalation.
  • Drive rigorous planning and execution across the team, ensuring strategic priorities have clear owners, milestones, metrics, and decision paths.
  • Identify operational friction and remove barriers that slow decision-making, partner execution, or cross-functional alignment.

Cross-Functional and Executive Leadership:
  • Lead highly matrixed work across Product, Global Technology, Data, Finance, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, Marketing, and business stakeholders.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to senior leaders, bringing clarity to ambiguous questions and structuring complex choices into practical decisions.
  • Prepare senior leaders for key planning and partner engagements, providing concise, actionable updates on priorities, performance, opportunities, risks, and decisions.

What You’ll Bring:
  • 12+ years of experience in strategy, strategic partnerships, business operations, corporate development, product strategy, consulting, or a related field.
  • Proven track record of developing strategy, operating models, and executive recommendations that drive measurable business, product, technology, or operational impact.
  • Experience leading market research, competitive analysis, technology landscape assessment, or strategic planning in a complex, fast-moving environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to build measurement frameworks, data-governance processes, and reporting that enable executive decision-making and portfolio management.
  • Strong analytical and financial acumen, with the ability to translate qualitative and quantitative inputs into clear recommendations.
  • Experience influencing and presenting to VP, SVP, C-suite, and external executive stakeholders.
  • Ability to lead and influence highly matrixed cross-functional teams, manage ambiguity, and drive decisions and execution at scale.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, quantitative discipline, technology, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Experience:
  • Experience supporting new-product strategy, partnerships, or growth initiatives in retail, eCommerce, consumer technology, enterprise technology, marketplaces, or platform businesses.
  • Experience with AI, data, cloud, or other emerging-technology ecosystems.
  • Experience building new operating rhythms and portfolio-management systems for a strategic partnerships, corporate strategy, product, or technology organization.

Job Description: Convergint is looking for a full-time, enthusiastic, results-driven, and forward-thinking Remote Services Technical Support Specialist to join our amazing culture. Under general supervision, the Technical Support Specialist II is responsible for configuring, commissioning, and supporting enterprise access control and video management systems across customer environments. This includes system programming, device integration, troubleshooting controllers and field hardware, and validating system functionality during startup and service activities.

The position requires high level hands-on experience with Lenel OnGuard & exacqVision, along with an understanding of door hardware, panels, readers, and field-level devices.

This role serves as a technical interface with customers, supporting live systems, resolving faults, and ensuring system performance aligns with operational requirements. Work includes remote diagnostics, coordination with field technicians, and occasional direct involvement in system commissioning and testing.

Candidates should have practical experience working with physical security systems in a service, project, or field support capacity. General IT experience alone is not sufficient for success in this role.

May provide guidance to less-experienced team members and support standardization of system configurations and support practices.

Who You Are

You have a passion for providing world-class service to customers, colleagues and communities. You are a person of integrity with a commitment to growth, accountability and delivering results. You want to join an organization with a positive culture that embraces equal opportunity and allows everyone to be the best version of themselves at work and home. You want to grow with us and deliver results. You are a problem solver with a passion for delivering accurate, high-quality work. You thrive on tackling challenging, large-scale projects and are eager to grow your skills. You are collaborative and technically skilled.

Who We Are
With 20 years of proven growth and exceptional performance, our mission is to be our customer’s best service provider. Our company is built upon a solid foundation of 10 Values and Beliefs that drive our unmatched culture, making us the #1 global, service-based systems integrator. We take pride in protecting the lives and assets of our customers and their communities with the solutions we provide.

What you’ll do with “Our Training and Your Experience”
Installs, programs, tests, repairs, and services physical security systems including access control and video surveillance platforms. Responsible for system configuration, device integration, and support of controllers, readers, cameras, and related field hardware. Acts as a primary technical interface for customers and is accountable for delivering a high level of service and satisfaction. Escalates only the most complex issues when required.
Reads and interprets blueprints, schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation to support installation, maintenance, and repair of physical security systems. Utilizes standard test equipment and tools to diagnose and resolve issues.
Executes all work in accordance with Provincial, local regulations, general best practices as well as company health and safety policies and procedures.
Commissions and validates system functionality through startup, testing, and performance analysis. Identifies faults, troubleshoots system issues, and implements corrective actions. Performs system programming and configuration as required.
Collaborates with supervisors and technical teams to resolve complex system issues, maintenance challenges, and warranty-related items.
Provides feedback on system performance, installation quality, and customer satisfaction. Recommends improvements to processes, standards, and system design where applicable.
Executes key technical aspects of projects including programming, system startup, testing, certification, customer training, and documentation. Supports ongoing service and maintenance of deployed systems.
Identifies risks related to system performance or project execution and communicates effectively to appropriate stakeholders. Assists in developing and implementing solutions to minimize impact to cost, schedule, and system reliability. Works closely with
Project Managers and supervisors to support project coordination and execution. Provides input on quality, scope changes, and opportunities to improve delivery and customer outcomes.
Provides mentorship and technical guidance to less-experienced staff. May support testing, tuning, and system optimization activities.
Acts as “our customer’s best service provider” at all times thereby ensuring Convergint Technologies is the customer’s first choice for service.
Communicates with and works with the other team members consistently to improve overall operations of the Convergint Technology Center, and company.
Keeps up to date and informed on all company policies.
Presents a professional image of Convergint Technologies at all times in appearance and behaviour.
Performs other duties and responsibilities as requested or required.

What You’ll Need
Strong customer focus and ability to work under pressure; ability to maintain awareness of, and seek to meet the needs and wants of the customer without being prompted
Solid technical skills and experience related to electronic security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intercom, …)
Prior experience with one the following brands:
· Milestone
· Genetec
· Lenel
· Avigilon
· CCURE
· Brivo
· Genea
· Alta
Solid programming skills and proven ability to troubleshoot problems and look for solutions
Must be a self-starter and work well without direct supervision
Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
Solid organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
Advanced computer skills including familiarity with MS Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel) and proficient in other relevant applications
Good skills with Spreadsheets and Data management
Good networking skills
Working knowledge of physical security and door Hardware
Understanding of relay and relay logic

Requirements:
High School diploma or equivalent.
Relevant trade experience preferred.
Minimum of 5-7 years of previous, relevant field experience required.
Experience in the electronic and security industry required.

Certifications: At least one active certification in video management systems (CCTV) and one active certification in access control from a recognized manufacturer or platform provider is preferred. Relevant platforms include enterprise systems such as LenelS2, Genetec, Software House (CCURE), Milestone, Avigilon, or similar.
Equivalent hands-on experience with these systems may be considered in place of formal certification, provided the candidate can demonstrate strong proficiency in system configuration, troubleshooting, and support.

Join NVIDIA's Accelerated Kubernetes Runtime team and be at the forefront of building the next generation of GPU-accelerated Kubernetes runtime distributions. As a Software Engineer on the Runtime team, you will design and build automation systems that enable engineers to seamlessly install, upgrade, and manage cluster runtime packages powering NVIDIA's AI Accelerators. You'll work on innovative controller systems that optimize runtime components for the latest GPU architectures including GB200/GB300, Vera Rubin and beyond, ensuring that AI researchers and developers have reliable, secure, and performant infrastructure at their fingertips.

The Runtime team is responsible for providing an NVIDIA-Accelerated Kubernetes runtime that can be applied to any cluster using NVIDIA accelerators, empowering engineers with automation-first, self-service tools that minimize manual effort while enhancing reliability and reproducibility.

What you will be doing:

  • Design and implement runtime features that orchestrate the lifecycle of runtime components across thousands of Kubernetes clusters without manual intervention

  • Build and maintain the systems that configure, package, validate, and distribute accelerated compute components

  • Develop Kubernetes controllers, CRDs, and operators that automate runtime installation, upgrade, and rollback operations with API driven workflows

What we need to see:

  • Bachelors in Computer Science, or equivalent experience

  • 8+ years of professional experience, with at least 3 years of experience with Kubernetes development

  • Experience building production Kubernetes systems with significant expertise in controllers, operators, and CustomResourceDefinitions

  • Strong proficiency in Go and experience building scalable Go services that manage complex distributed systems

  • Hands-on experience with Helm, Kustomize, and managing Kubernetes manifest packaging and templating

  • Demonstrated ability to design and implement automation systems that replace manual processes with reliable, self-service tooling

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience working with NVIDIA Kubernetes components such as GPU operator, device plugins, or other HPC components in large scale production environments

  • Deep familiarity with OCI registries, artifact signing, SBOM generation, and supply chain security practices

  • Experience building multi-tenant platform services with focus on API design, versioning, and backward compatibility

  • Track record of migrating legacy systems to modern, automated platforms while maintaining zero-downtime operations and contributions to upstream Kubernetes/CNCF projects or experience extending Kubernetes API machinery

  • Deep understanding of Kubernetes architecture including API machinery, admission controllers, and resource lifecycle management

NVIDIA is leading the way in groundbreaking developments in Artificial Intelligence, High-Performance Computing and Visualization. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens up new universes to explore, enables amazing creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions from artificial intelligence to autonomous cars. NVIDIA is looking for great people like you to help us accelerate the next wave of artificial intelligence. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world's most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people on the planet working for us. If you're a creative, curious, and driven technical leader, we want to hear from you!

184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

Who We Are

Contrails.org is a pioneering non-profit working to establish proven contrail avoidance at scale. We are a small, focused team of scientists, engineers, and aviation experts building the science, tools, and operational playbooks to make contrail management a practical reality. Our open-source modelling framework underpins research worldwide, and our real-world trials with major airlines demonstrate that contrail avoidance delivers verifiable climate benefit at a minimal cost.

Our mission is to meaningfully reduce contrail-induced warming by 2030, while establishing the foundations for contrail avoidance to become standard practice in global aviation. We envision a world where intelligent route planning and air traffic management eliminates climate warming contrails with near-zero cost.

Contrails currently cause the same warming impact as 33 billion tonnes of atmospheric CO₂—roughly one year of global anthropogenic emissions. A small subset of flights generates the bulk of this contrail warming, much of which can be avoided through minor altitude or routing adjustments at negligible cost.

What You’ll Do

Contrails.org is seeking a highly motivated and exceptional trial-focused Research Scientist to join our team. You will plan, execute, analyze, and report on real-world flight trials of contrail avoidance, working closely with partner airlines and air navigation service providers (ANSPs) to demonstrate contrail management at scale. You will design scientifically defensible trials, monitor them as they run, turn trial data into actionable results, and communicate those results to research partners and the broader aviation and scientific community. This role sits within the Contrail Clearing Accelerator (CCA), which will run trials across 4 to 8 airlines and 1 to 2 ANSPs. As part of the CCA, you will help design a standardized trial methodology that can be applied across disparate airlines and ANSPs.

Specific Responsibilities

Development and analysis of flight trials

  • Collaborate with our team, partner airlines, and ANSPs to develop trial options and to design, develop, and implement real-world trials of contrail avoidance.
  • Use Contrails.org and partner tools to plan high-impact, scientifically defensible trials, including pre-test modeling of contrail impacts and effects of trial design decisions.
  • Monitor the progress of trials in execution, including accessing raw data sources, converting data into insights, and clearly communicating trial progress to stakeholders.
  • Conduct post-trial analysis, determining avoidance effectiveness and costs using modeled and observed results, and uncovering relevant human and operational factors.
  • Cross-check flight planning outputs, filed flight plans, flown telemetry, and satellite observations to verify what avoidance was attempted and achieved.
  • Work with partners to provide data and support in using our tools to facilitate the success of trials.

Operational protocol development

  • Document trial learnings and operational findings in a form that supports the development of repeatable, safety-sound operational protocols and playbooks.
  • Support the translation of trial results into procedures and guidance usable by airline and ANSP partners.

Innovation and problem solving

  • Identify innovative solutions to complex technical and operational challenges in trial design and execution, enhancing scientific understanding and technological capabilities and performance.
  • Continuously improve analysis and tools in response to partner feedback.

Collaboration and communication

  • Work closely with team members to align trial work with strategic objectives.
  • Build and help maintain relationships with partner airlines and ANSPs, including preparing briefing materials and representing Contrails.org in partner meetings and before external audiences.
  • Participate in and lead meetings with research and trial partners.
  • Communicate technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders, fostering a collaborative and cohesive work environment.
  • Lead and contribute to written publications in peer-reviewed journals, industry white papers, and our Notebook, describing and contextualizing trial results.
  • Present your work and trial results at international workshops and conferences, and to scientific and industry audiences.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, physics, computer science, data science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in engineering, aviation operations, data science, or a related field.
  • Experience conducting independent research or analysis with minimal oversight.
  • Proficiency in Python or similar programming languages.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to explain scientific concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to rapidly changing requirements.
  • Available for up to 20% travel domestically and internationally.
  • Ability to occasionally work outside standard hours to accommodate partner meetings across diverse time zones.

Preferred

  • Aviation domain expertise, including familiarity with operational and human factors. Flight test expertise particularly valued.
  • Master’s or PhD degree in a relevant field.
  • Experience implementing or working with aircraft performance, aircraft emissions, or contrail models.
  • Experience using optimizers or building scripts to support route or trial planning.
  • Experience running statistical analysis on large datasets using cloud computing.

Salary and Benefits

$120,000 to $140,000 depending on experience, plus a generous benefits package that includes:

  • 10% employer 401(k) contribution
  • Up to $2,500 a month toward medical coverage for you and your dependents
  • Dental and vision covered by Contrails, currently provided as a monthly stipend
  • 20 paid vacation days
  • 17 paid company holidays
  • 12 paid sick days

Commitment to Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Contrails.org values diversity in all forms and is dedicated to inclusive and transparent recruitment, selection, and promotion processes. Candidates with diverse backgrounds and lived experiences are strongly encouraged to apply. Candidates must have the right to work in the United States.

How to Apply

Apply through this page with your resume and a short answer to the experience question on the application form. Applications close November 20, 2026.

Salary: $120,000 – $140,000 / year

raw.title: French Speaking Rust Coding Evaluation Specialist
raw.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. 

About the project 

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. 

About the roles 

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. 

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. 

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. 

Who we are looking for 

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. 

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language 

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. 

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail. 

Project at a glance 

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November 

  • Language: French

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person 

  • Project compensation: US$60 - US$80 per hour

  • Work location: fully remote 

How selection works (major steps) 

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability. 

  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language. 

  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track. 

  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role. 

  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

raw.title: French Speaking Go Coding Evaluation Specialist
raw.excerpt: Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English.
raw.description:
Join a short, paid project that tests whether AI coding agents work as well on instructions written in the target language as they do in English. Your language skills and technical background decide where you fit. 

About the project 

Welo Data is helping evaluate how well AI coding agents perform when the instructions they receive are written in languages other than English. Agents are given a real software engineering task in a code repository, and automated tests check whether they solved it. The code, repositories and tests stay exactly as they are. Only the human-written instructions change language, so the quality of every instruction directly affects the result. 

About the roles 

There are two roles on this project. We place you in one of them based on your experience & skillsets. 

  • Translator: translate English software engineering task briefs into the target language. You keep every requirement, constraint and success condition, and you leave commands, file paths, API names, code and test conditions exactly as written in English. This role suits people with a stronger technical background, and translation experience is a plus. 

  • Reviewer: compare each translation with the English source, check that nothing is missing, added or changed in meaning, correct errors, and log each correction by error type. This role suits people with strong translation, editing or review experience and enough technical familiarity to read code context. 

Who we are looking for 

  • Native or near-native writing in the target language, and strong reading ability in English. 

  • Either professional experience in translation, editing, review or technical writing, or a software background combined with excellent writing in the target language 

  • Comfort reading technical text. Coding experience is a strong plus for the translation role and helpful for the review role. 

  • Close attention to detail. In this project, a dropped clause can make a task fail. 

Project at a glance 

  • Project duration: one week since the mid of November 

  • Language: French

  • Project time commitment: 6 hours per person 

  • Project compensation: US$60 - US$80 per hour

  • Work location: fully remote 

How selection works (major steps) 

  1. Screening questions: about 2 minutes. They cover your language background, translation and review experience, which programming languages you know and how well, and your availability. 

  2. Language test: short exercises in the target language. 

  3. Programming skills assessment: you will be invited to another opportunity, in the programming language you know best (Rust, Go, Python, or TypeScript / JavaScript). It confirms your technical level and places you in a language track. 

  4. Financial Onboarding & Role placement: complete the financial onboarding with Welo Data. In the meanwhile, you will be informed about the decision whether you are placed in the initial translation role or the review role. 

  5. Production: once you finish all steps above, our project team will contact you for production.

First things first: do you enjoy solving problems, writing clean code, and figuring out how to make things work better without making them unnecessarily complicated? If so, you might be a great fit for Seez.

Seez is an AI-powered automotive technology company transforming how vehicles are bought and sold. Since 2016, we've been building scalable SaaS and digital retail solutions that help dealerships, OEMs, and marketplaces deliver smarter, more seamless car buying experiences. We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong frontend capabilities, solid backend experience, and a knack for finding practical solutions to real problems.

You'll work across multiple live products, contribute to new features, improve existing applications, and collaborate closely with our Product, Design, Backend, QA, and DevOps teams. This is a great opportunity for someone who's confident in their technical abilities but still hungry to learn, take on greater ownership, and grow into a technical leadership role. We're not looking for someone who knows everything. We're looking for someone with strong foundations, good judgment, and the curiosity to keep getting better.

JOB KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Technical & Engineering
    • Develop, maintain and improve web applications with Node.js, Vue.js and/or React.
    • Balance new features, maintenance and improvements across multiple production applications and repositories.
    • Work within existing architectures, design systems and shared engineering standards, extending what exists before building something new.
    • Write clean, maintainable code and favor simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.
    • Work with DevOps on CI/CD (Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery), deployments and infrastructure.
    • Troubleshoot issues and improve performance and reliability.
  • Product & Collaboration
    • Understand the business need and the client behind each feature, and turn requirements into practical implementations.
    • Challenge assumptions constructively and suggest alternatives, including simpler scopes, when you see a better route.
    • Balance technical quality, timelines and product priorities.
    • Communicate clearly, exchange feedback openly, and collaborate with colleagues across different disciplines and working styles.
  • Ownership & Growth
    • Take responsibility for assigned features and projects, from development through delivery and maintenance.
    • Build confidence in making technical decisions and progressively take on more complex responsibilities.
    • Share knowledge, contribute to team discussions, and support less experienced engineers.
    • Seek feedback, learn from challenges, and actively contribute to improving how the team works.
    • Develop the technical judgment, communication, and mentoring skills needed to grow into future leadership opportunities.

Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO THE PARTY (MUST HAVES)

  • Around 4–7 years of professional software engineering experience, with demonstrated experience building and maintaining production applications.
  • Strong proficiency in Node.js, with solid expertise in either Vue.js or React and the ability to learn the other quickly.
  • Experience working across both frontend and backend development.
  • Experience maintaining existing products and navigating established codebases, not just building applications from scratch.
  • Working knowledge of Jenkins, Cloudflare, AWS S3, and CI/CD workflows.
  • Understanding of software architecture, design systems, coding standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Good problem-solving skills and the judgment to choose practical solutions over unnecessary complexity.
  • A collaborative mindset and the confidence to give, receive, and act on constructive feedback.
  • An understanding of how technical decisions influence user experience and business outcomes.
  • A willingness to adapt, take ownership, and continuously improve.

YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU’RE SOMEONE (GREAT-TO-HAVE)

  • Experience mentoring junior engineers or supporting technical onboarding.
  • Experience contributing to engineering standards or process improvements.
  • Exposure to technical planning, architectural discussions, or feature ownership.
  • Familiarity with automotive or SaaS products.
  • An interest in progressing toward technical or people leadership.

OUR TECH ENVIRONMENT

  • Backend: Node.js

  • Frontend: Vue.js and React
  • CI/CD: Jenkins
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Cloudflare and AWS S3
  • Ways of Working: Shared engineering standards, established design systems, and cross-functional product development.

Benefits

  • 25 days of paid annual leave plus public holidays
  • Flexible remote work options
  • Open door policy to CEO and all Leadership team
  • One-on-one wellness coaching sessions because your well-being matters.
  • An annual wellness budget to fuel whatever keeps you balanced—whether that’s yoga, hiking, or visit to the museum.
  • An annual learning budget to power your growth—be it a new course, certification, or skill you’ve been eyeing
  • Regular team events, social calls, the best company SWAG, and a vibrant remote culture

WHY JOIN SEEZ?

At Seez, we’re all about attracting and keeping top talent, the kind of people who bring ideas, energy, and curiosity to the table. We’ve created a space where great work gets noticed, collaboration is second nature, and our values aren’t just posters on the wall; they guide everything we do.

We’re a colorful mix of cultures, backgrounds, and perspectives. Everyone has a voice, a purpose, and the freedom to show up as their real self. It’s the kind of place where you can do meaningful work, grow quickly, enjoy a healthy work-life balance, and shape your own career path.

Cash Application Specialist

Accounts Receivable / Finance Operations

Work Model: 100% Remote

Employment Type: Full-Time

Build Your Career With Alia Services

Alia Services connects talented professionals with growing companies around the world. We specialize in remote recruitment, workforce, and payroll solutions, helping organizations build exceptional teams while creating meaningful career opportunities for professionals.

We are looking for a detail-oriented Cash Application Specialist to join our client's Accounts Receivable team. This role is responsible for managing all aspects of cash application, credit card transactions, and customer payment processing, ensuring accurate and timely posting of incoming payments.

If you have experience in cash applications and Accounts Receivable, enjoy working with financial transactions, and have strong organizational and problem-solving skills, this is an excellent opportunity to grow your career in an international business environment.

Why Join Alia Services?

At Alia Services, we want our team members to feel supported throughout their employment while having opportunities to grow professionally. As part of our team, you'll have access to:

  • 100% Remote Work – Work from the comfort of your home while collaborating with an international team and client.

  • Health Insurance – Health insurance coverage provided through SafetyWing, beginning as soon as you are hired.

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) – Enjoy paid time off to rest, recharge, and maintain a healthy work-life balance.

  • Reliable Payroll – Consistent payroll administration and support from the Alia Services team.

  • Dedicated HR Support – Access to our People Operations team for employment-related questions, support, and guidance throughout your time with us.

  • Professional Growth – Opportunities to develop your skills, gain international experience, and grow within your role.

  • Coaching & Feedback – Ongoing mentorship, leadership guidance, and development opportunities.

  • International Experience – Gain valuable experience working with international companies and teams.

  • Ongoing Employee Support – From onboarding through your day-to-day employment, Alia Services serves as your dedicated partner throughout your experience with the client.

About the Role

As a Cash Application Specialist, you will be responsible for processing incoming customer payments through various methods, including checks, wire transfers, and credit card transactions. You will ensure payments are accurately applied and posted, handle payment-related inquiries and disputes, and collaborate closely with Accounts Receivable, Credit, Sales, and Account Executives.

This position also involves managing rebates and coupons, recording write-offs in the General Ledger (GL), identifying trends or recurring issues in the cash posting process, and supporting the team in meeting service-level agreements (SLAs).

What You'll Do

Cash Application & Payment Processing

  • Receive and process incoming payments from customers, clients, and other sources through various payment methods, including checks, wire transfers, and credit card payments.

  • Deposit and post cash payments and physical checks received at the office location.

  • Process credit card transactions, including pre-charging, charging, posting, and handling disputes through multiple channels, such as customer self-service portals and dedicated phone lines.

  • Ensure accurate and timely application of customer payments to the appropriate accounts.

  • Enter rebates and coupons into the system and ensure corresponding write-off amounts are properly recorded in the General Ledger (GL).

  • Perform accurate transactional posting against General Ledger (GL) accounts.

  • Maintain an overall understanding of the Accounts Receivable process and related financial transactions.

Customer Communication & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contact customers via telephone and email regarding payment application questions, discrepancies, or credit card issues.

  • Collaborate with Credit and Accounts Receivable teams, as well as Sales Executives, to resolve deposit-related questions and obtain customer remittance information.

  • Work closely with Sales teams and leadership to identify and communicate trends observed during the cash posting process, including insufficient or inaccurate information provided by customers or Sales teams.

  • Manage all incoming calls during assigned time frames or shifts to meet established Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

  • Perform additional duties and responsibilities as assigned.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED.

  • At least 1 year of direct cash application experience in an office environment.

  • At least 1 year of experience in Accounts Receivable (AR).

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook.

  • Strong communication and active listening skills, with the ability to communicate effectively in person, over the phone, via email, and through video conferences.

  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills.

  • Demonstrated problem-solving abilities and sound judgment when prioritizing tasks and managing time independently.

  • Ability to work overtime when required.

  • Openness to learning, receiving constructive feedback, and responding positively to feedback from others.

  • Appreciation for curiosity, creativity, inclusive teamwork, and achieving results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate Degree in Accounting.

  • Intermediate Excel skills, including experience with Pivot Tables and VLOOKUP.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

You'll be a strong fit if you are detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable handling financial transactions with accuracy. You understand the importance of timely payment application, enjoy resolving discrepancies, and can communicate effectively with customers and internal teams. You're also proactive in identifying recurring issues, making sound decisions, and contributing to an efficient Accounts Receivable operation.

Ready to make a difference?

The successful candidate will combine deep software-engineering skills, product thinking, strong communication, and an AI-first mindset. They will translate analytical methods and client needs into secure, reliable, maintainable software while contributing engineering improvements across Sightline ADAPT.

DROP has progressed from an analytical concept into a product with automated workflows supporting customer and device assignments, program operations, data preprocessing, telemetry processing, performance analysis, and reporting. The next phase requires disciplined software engineering focused on reliability, extensibility, repeatable deployment, and continued product improvement.

Production Engineering and Data Integration

  • Improve automated testing, CI/CD, logging, monitoring, error handling, data validation, deployment practices, and operational documentation.
  • Develop and maintain data-intensive Python and SQL workflows in Microsoft Azure and Databricks environments.
  • Integrate DROP with utility data sources, DERMS platforms, APIs, telemetry feeds, storage services, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, and client environments as applicable.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to define reliable schemas, interfaces, data-quality controls, and secure configuration patterns.

AI-First Engineering and Product Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted engineering tools to improve development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and delivery efficiency while maintaining accountability for quality and correctness.
  • Apply team standards for privacy, security, intellectual-property protection, auditability, evaluation, and human oversight when using AI-enabled tools or building AI-enabled features.
  • Identify practical opportunities to incorporate generative AI, agentic workflows, machine learning, or automation into DROP and the software-development process.
  • Evaluate AI-generated code and outputs critically through review, testing, validation, and monitoring.

What we need you to have (minimum qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data engineering, engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of software development or data-product engineering experience.
  • Experience building and supporting production web applications in cloud environments.
  • Strong software engineering experience with Python, SQL, APIs, data pipelines, front-end technologies, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience with Git, automated testing, CI/CD, monitoring, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Ability to build reliable, maintainable software, leverage AI-assisted development tools, and translate product, analytical, and client requirements into technical solutions.

What we would like you to have:

  • Master’s degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, information systems, or a related field.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, Databricks, Apache Spark, Docker, Power BI, or Microsoft Fabric.
  • Experience with React, Next.js, FastAPI, .NET, or comparable modern full-stack frameworks.
  • Experience building data-intensive SaaS products or configurable software using time-series, telemetry, event, AMI, or other high-volume operational data.
  • Experience operationalizing machine-learning, optimization, generative-AI, or agentic capabilities, including evaluation and monitoring.
  • Experience integrating software with third-party platforms, APIs, identity services, and client data environments.
  • Experience with demand response, distributed energy resources, virtual power plants, DERMS, utility customer programs, or grid-interactive technologies.
  • Experience modernizing analytical code or converting data-science workflows into production software.
  • Experience supporting client-facing technical discussions, proposals, demonstrations, or implementation planning.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer.
